topics: Introduction - History of Lean – Toyota Production System (TPS)- Ford Production System (FPS)- Principle of Lean Manufacturing- Seven Wastes, their causes and the effects- Conventional Manufacturing versus Lean Manufacturing

5-S, Workplace organization, Total Productive Maintenance, Process mapping/ Value stream mapping, Work cell, Cause and Effect diagram, Pareto chart, Spider chart, Poka yoke, Kanban, Automation, Single minute exchange of die (SMED), Just in time (JIT), Visual workplace, OEE

Introduction to Lean Concepts like In-Built Quality, Concept of Right Part at the Right Time, Lead Time reduction, Optimum utilization of Capital, Optimum utilization of People. Understanding the Zero-defect concept and Metrics, Focus on Human Resources, Quality and Delivery Cost. Building Zero defect capabilities, Cultural and Organizational aspects
Introduction to six sigma- basic tools of six sigma like problem solving approach, standard deviation, normal distribution. DMAIV and DMADV.
Agile manufacturing - Definition, business need, conceptual frame work, characteristics, and generic features -Approaches to enhance ability in manufacturing - Managing people in agile organization

partA.description:
2 Questions from each module.
Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description:
Each question carries 9 marks.
Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.
Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Identify and understand the key concepts in lean manufacturing.
Select the lean manufacturing tools to find and eliminate wastes
Identify and improve a manufacturing system by applying lean manufacturing principles and tools
Understanding the key concepts of six sigma
Identify the framework of agile manufacturing
